verdict: Paid channels are paused; organic presence is active but softening.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, no spend ran on Meta or Google Ads — every engagement came from Google Business Profile and organic search. Combined, your listings generated 411 GBP actions (directions, calls, and website clicks) in the last 28 days, which shows real market interest finding you without paid support. That said, GBP activity is trending down at all three locations — most sharply at O'Hare Precision, which saw a 77% week-over-week drop — and that decline is being addressed now. Website conversion tracking is also being repaired at two locations, so the full picture of how visitors move from search to inquiry is currently under-reported.
